s.how: Whisk 3 eggs with 200ml milk, 1 tsp vanilla and a pinch of salt. Cut 6 thick slices white bread into 3 fingers each. Soak each finger for 10 seconds and fry in batches in 40g butter over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden. Roll straight away in 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Serve with 125ml warm maple syrup for dipping.

Simmer 500g cocktail frankfurts in 125ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp yellow mustard and 2 tbsp water for 10 minutes, stirring until sticky and glossy. Pile into a warm bowl with toothpicks for picking.

m.note: best not ask what's in it
m.how: Soak 80g breadcrumbs in 100ml milk, then mix lightly with 500g beef mince, 250g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 1 egg and Worcestershire. Shape in a loaf tin, glaze with 4 tbsp tomato sauce and 1 tbsp brown sugar and bake at 180C for an hour.

w.note: Frank brings his creation to life on its birthday
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Fill with strawberry jam and 200ml whipped cream. Cover in 200g butter beaten with 350g icing sugar, brush with edible gold and add candles.

d.note: the red lips singing in the dark
d.how: Chill 4 coupes. For each drink, shake 40ml vodka, 15ml orange liqueur, 30ml cranberry juice and 15ml lime juice with plenty of ice for 15 seconds. Strain into the coupes. Hold a strip of orange peel over each glass, warm it with a match and squeeze so the oil flashes, then drop it in. Totals are 160ml vodka and 60ml orange liqueur.
